user.title: Google Fonts Icons
user.description: Adds the Material Symbols icon set from Google Fonts to Home Assistant. Use them anywhere an icon can be set, for example gfi:rocket_launch.

data_description.style: Used by the gfi: prefix. The other styles stay available as gfio:, gfir: and gfis:.
data_description.weight: Thickness of the icon strokes, 400 matches the Google Fonts default.
data_description.offline_pack: Downloads the icon package once (about 2 MB) so icons work without internet. When off, single icons are fetched from the CDN as they are used.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Google Fonts Icons is already set up.

init.title: Google Fonts Icons
init.description: Changes apply after Home Assistant reloads the integration and the browser page is refreshed.
